versions.content: If FrNmPnEnabled is TRUE and a NM-PDU has to be transmitted (either as NM-PDU with requested PNCs or as PN shutdown message), the FrNm module shall additionally fetch the PNC bit vector by calling Nm_PncBitVectorTxIndication and copy the PNC bit vector with respect to NmPncBitVectorOffset and NmPncBitVectorLength of the corresponding NM-channel to the NM-PDU before requesting the transmission of the NM-PDU.
